descriptions.zh-Hans: 在东京尝荞麦面时留下的小菜单。这回先写了菜名，又从容地添上“好吃”。
descriptions.en: A card from trying soba in Tokyo. The name went down first, then a leisurely “delicious.”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在东京吃文字烧后留下的菜单，旁边记着铁板上小小的滋滋声。
descriptions.en: My Tokyo monjayaki card, with a small written sizzle from the hot griddle beside it.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 东京塔的333米让我念了三拍，一位旅人帮忙添上第四拍。我把四个小点都留下了。
descriptions.en: Tokyo Tower’s 333 meters gave me three beats; a traveler supplied a fourth. I kept all four as pencil dots.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在东京尝文字烧时给自己记的声音，后面三个小点像还想接着说话。
descriptions.en: My own sound note from monjayaki in Tokyo, with three trailing dots that still seem to have something to add.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在东京上野公园散步时，我停下来给随身便纸写上“先歇会儿”。
descriptions.en: “Rest first,” written on my own slip during a pause in a walk through Tokyo’s Ueno Park.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在东京，我和一位旅人轮流念荞麦面与文字烧的小菜单。这张便纸记着我们的出场顺序。
descriptions.en: A traveler and I read my Tokyo soba and monjayaki menu cards in turn. This slip keeps the running order of our very short play.
